pull.title: fees: prevent divide by zero in CFeeRate
pull.body:
A CFeeRate with size 0 `GetFeePerK()` and `CFeeRate+=` evaluated `EvaluateFeeDown(1000)` unconditionally, dividing by that zero size and crashing.

Return 0 for an empty fee rate, matching `GetFee()` behaviour, and add minimal unit test coverage.

This was reported by Jacob F Cudney (aragondragon)
